First, there is no evidence that Devon Gray paid sufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the 2025-26 tax year — the only tax document covers a different year (a3 UNKNOWN). Second, the Gift Aid declaration on file is incomplete, with the page specifying its coverage and duration missing, so it cannot be confirmed as a valid declaration covering this donation (a4 UNKNOWN).
